description: 把需求做成公司同事能登录使用的企业应用：建应用、写代码、部署开发版、平台真机验收、发布正式版；自带企业微信登录、功能权限、数据库、文件上传和定时任务。

display.description_en: Turn a request into an internal app your colleagues can sign in to: create the app, write the code, deploy a dev build, let the platform verify it in a real browser, then publish. WeCom login, permissions, a database, file storage and scheduled jobs are built in.
display.description_zh: 把需求做成公司同事能登录使用的企业应用：建应用、写代码、部署开发版、平台真机验收、发布正式版；自带企业微信登录、功能权限、数据库、文件上传和定时任务。
examples_en: Turn this Excel ledger into a system my whole department can sign in to and fill in
Build an approval system for leave, expense and purchase requests: staff submit on their phones, managers approve, finance can look things up, and it's obvious where each request is stuck

Set up daily inspections for our stores (or workshops): checklists go out on schedule, staff tick items and take photos on site, failures auto-create rectification tasks, and HQ's dashboard shows who hasn't done theirs
Build a repair-and-complaint ticket system: scan a code to report, auto-assign an owner, track progress, and push overdue tickets to our WeCom group every morning
Keep an eye on contracts, licenses and stock for me: remind the owner on WeCom when something is about to expire or drops below safety stock, and send leadership a weekly summary
examples_zh: 把这个 Excel 台账做成部门同事都能登录填写的系统
做一个请假、报销、采购申请的审批系统：员工手机上提交，主管审批，财务能查，谁卡在哪一步一眼能看到
给门店（或车间）做一套每日巡检：按计划自动下发检查清单，现场拍照打勾，不合格自动派整改单，总部看板里能看到谁没做
做一个设备报修和客诉工单系统：扫码报修，自动派给负责人，进度随时可查，逾期的每天早上推到企业微信群
帮我盯着合同、证照和库存：快到期或低于安全库存时自动提醒到负责人的企业微信，领导每周收一份汇总
